messages:
Maya: Heads-up: OnPrem EdgeLite v1.0 goes GA tonight for customers who need a low-telemetry deployment. Key change: tenant-level telemetry toggle (default: off). Rolling out during the maintenance window below. Share any customer blockers here. :tada:
release-bot: Tag: edge-lite@v1.0 published to s3://internal-releases/edge-lite/v1.0. Rollout window: 2025-07-01 01:00 UTC -> 2025-07-01 05:00 UTC. Canary: 10% for first 60m.
Jordan: Clarifying Q — default is opt-out (telemetry disabled) for on-prem customers? We had one customer asking for explicit opt-in only.
Maya: Correct. Default telemetry state is off for Private/on-prem. Customers can enable per-tenant via Console or agent API. Hosted/Dedicated remain unchanged.
infra-bot: Canary health checks green in us-central1 and eu-north-1 for the last 15m. No 5xx errors.
support-team: Support schedule: @Jordan and @Maya covering the rollout window. Backup: @Sam. Escalate connectivity issues to #eng-runtime.
Maya: Short customer readiness checklist:
- Open port 15012 (management) in customer firewall (runtime stays on 15011).
- Provide KMS/HSM credentials if they want encrypted telemetry envelopes.
- Capture telemetry consent decision in onboarding doc (we store consent metadata).
- Run edge-lite preflight and attach results to the support ticket.
Example API call to disable tenant telemetry:
`curl -X POST https://mgmt.customer.example/api/v1/tenants/abcd/telemetry -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"enabled":false}'`
Jordan: Any cert rotations or agent schema changes?
Maya: No cert rotation required. Agent now exposes the management plane on 15012 (new). No schema changes to runtime payloads.
Jordan: Compliance note: when enabled, telemetry contains only hashed metric keys and non-identifying counters; we never ship raw prompt text. Retention defaults to 30 days; SOC2 pack updated.
Maya: I'll post customer email templates and update the Console copy after this thread. Monitoring will be live for 4 hours post-rollout. :rotating_light:
